t: Deliver the letter informing the Gray Family of the successful completion of the ship.

We have good news for the Gray Family. We're delivering the ship on time! Go to Novograd and tell the ambassador that he can start putting a crew together. If it wasn't for our old injuries, we'd stand on the captain's bridge ourselves and shout...
"Cast off!"
See? We're still good for some things like shouting. Oh, and singing of course!
"Ye bold Kanian sirs, who search for glory indeed..."
Well? Will the ship be delivered in time? Come on, make an old man happy!

Praise Tensess! You know, it's such a hassle with each ship - it's always one thing or another... Like with a baby! But then it's such a relief when it's finally all over! Just to be able to start again. The League wants the ships, you can't buck it.
Your help has been invaluable. Please, take this.
Kill the Runaway Satyr and report back to the Husky Family.

One of our other runaway beasts is a satyr. A terrible one at that - our hearts skip a beat every time we think of it. We've heard some tavern rumors that it's been spotted along the Astral coast, near the Farshore Shipyard.
It must have gone completely mad to make for the coast and, unfortunately, if that's the condition it's in then it's especially dangerous. Please go there and find and kill the beast. We don't want it harming the nearby shipbuilders! It won't be an easy task, but trust us, when it's all over, we'll give you a nice reward.
Have you been to the shipyard yet? Did you find the satyr?
Now that's better, much better. Too bad it couldn't have ended more happily. The beast would have had a much better time living in a zoo than dead. Here's your reward.
Meet with Izbor Yavorsky in Aidenus' Tower and tell him everything you have learned.

This is getting serious.
It's time to inform the League Defenders on what's happening - external threats are their business.
The first squad of League Defenders was created after the Night of Astral Portals when Tensess died and the old capital was consumed by the Astral. It was a terrible time...
That's when Aidenus issued the order to create a professional army. The League needed a reliable shield! Defenders were selected from among the best of the best - regardless of heritage.
Now that the demonic threat has, for the most part, been eliminated, the main job of the defenders is fighting the Empire. The League's headquarters are located here in Aidenus' Tower here in Novograd. Izbor Yavorsky is in charge there - go see him and tell him what you managed to find out. He'll decide what to do from there.
Good day, my friend! Busy as always?
Zhuga was right to send you to me. The war with the Empire is our concern.
Deliver the order to assault the Oreshek Fortress to commander Vladimir Zalesky.

It's time for drastic measures.
We must reclaim Oreshek Fortress, save the kidnapped Elven wizard, and prevent the rebels from opening the portal to Igsh.
You must get to the outpost as soon as possible. Our attempts to recapture the Oreshek Fortress have so far been futile, but if we hesitate then soon all will be lost.
You are to contact Vladimir Zalesky, the Kanian commander in charge of the operation. Tell him all you've learned and deliver the order to take Oreshek at any cost!

Seizing the fortress... As if we're playing games here! That's the most impregnable fortress I've ever known! Damnit, we built it for ourselves!
Honestly, I'd prefer to assault Tensess Temple a hundred times to trying to drive these renegades from Oreshek!
Use the repair kit to fix 3 catapults and report back to Vladimir Zalesky.

Our first attempt to make a gap in the wall was a big, fat bust. As soon as we started our attack, the rebels made a charge and killed the cannon crews and broke the catapults.
Here, if you want to help, there's no better way than to just get right in the middle of it. Go to the siege line and fix the broken catapults. Perhaps one soldier will be able do what many could not. The cannons will definitely be guarded, so be prepared to fight. That's the only way we can crack this fortress' defenses!
I hope you've brought good news. Are those catapults fixed?
By the Light! At last there's someone who's done something useful. I'll order the cannon crews to start shelling the fortress' walls at once.
Use the Pulsomer to find 3 rebel spies near the central watchtower and eliminate them. Report to the governor Vladimir Zalesky afterwards.

Now we need to hold a safe point that we can shell the fortress from. There are several guard towers standing halfway between us and the fortress. Seize the central one and hold it while the attack is underway. The enemy will surely want to reclaim it but don't let them do that! As soon as the initial bombardment is over, come back and we'll proceed to the operation's crucial phase.
Remember, you have to defend the tower the entire time. If you die or flee, the enemy will take the tower and all our efforts will be for nothing. We'll have to start back at square one.
My advice is that you find yourself a partner for this task. The enemy will surely use his best troops to assault your position, and you'll be better off if you have someone covering your back.
The main task now is to crack Oreshek Fortress by making a gap in its walls. The key to this whole operation is holding that guard tower.

Hah, I'm already looking forward to the big moment when we burst into the fortress and kill the bastards! My war council has developed a detailed assault plan. You should talk to all the council members and learn what your part in the future operation is.
Kill the Runaway Troll and report back to the Husky Family.

You've done well, but those first two assignments were just tests. We wanted to see if you could actually handle our main concern. You see, our feature attraction at the zoo was supposed to be a real live troll!
When our ship wrecked, the wild beast took off looking for trouble the first chance he got. We know roughly where to look - somewhere where there's war and corpses. That's where the monster will go, attracted by the scent of blood.
Can you think of any places like that? Hmm, what a gloomy thought. We know - you should head to Cape Lookout where Oreshek Fortress stands. There's a battle in full swing around it. When the troll is dead, the sad story of our attempt to start a zoo will be over. When you return there'll be a reward waiting for you.
This has been the most stressful time in our lives! We nearly ran out of hope, but your actions have salvaged the situation. Thanks so much for your help!
Infiltrate Oreshek Fortress, find incriminating enemy papers, and hoist the League banner on the spire and report to the commander upon completion.

Okay, here's the plan - our Astral ship attacks the fortress from the north and lands troops under the fortress' walls. Simultaneously, our land troops start the assault. This way, we will distract the rebel forces, making it easier for you to accomplish your main goal.
Break into the courtyard and hoist the League banner on the fortress spire. That will be a signal for the reserves to attack. Besides, when the rebels see our flag raised behind their backs, they'll think that the fortress is no longer in their hands. That will undermine their morale and make them easier prey for my soldiers.
The outcome of the assault depends on your success. Don't fail us!
Oh yes, and keep your eyes open while you're in enemy territory. You might notice some documents or something that could be of great interest to us.
Where's the signal? Where's the victory banner?

Victory... By the Light, I thought I'd never be able to utter that word again. The League banner is flying proudly over the fortress, the rebellion has been quelled, and it's all thanks to you. So, take this reward from me - a weapon engraved with your name. Let it be of use to you, while continuing to serve the League.
Eliminate 2 Defiant Sorcerers and 2 Defiant Fighters in the outskirts of Oreshek. Report back to Vladimir Zalesky.

Would you like to offer your services for the good of the League? If so, then I have a task for you.
This one Elf told me that many of our diseases are spread by insects - flies, mosquitoes, and so on. Allegedly, they carry the infections from host to host, spreading death all over the allod.
Whether or not that's true I cannot say... But what I can say is that the infection of mutiny is spread by rebels, those who subvert the mind and propagate evil!
The only solution is to destroy the carriers of this disease, a task that you should be doing just about every day. The more successful you are, the more honor and respect you will garner!
Has the virus of the rebellion been dealt with?
Excellent! The League will never forget your help!
Find the missing Gibberling Scout in Oreshek Fortress.

Greetings! It seems that fate has thrown us together again and we must unite our efforts once more.
I'm here by the order of the Gibberling Embassy. The army is in need of skillful scouts. I managed to infiltrate the fortress and gather some intelligence about the enemy forces, but that is not the matter at hand.
While I was in the fortress I saw a fellow Gibberling. He's a scout who lead one of the expeditions that searched for our homeland. Like me, he is now on his own, for it seems that the enemy did not spare his brothers...
There was no way for me to talk to him, but since you're going to the fortress you can find him for me! The findings from his expedition in search of Isa are very important to us Gibberlings, so he must be saved!
I suggest you don't go into Oreshek Fortress on your own - I tried and failed. Don't repeat my mistake. Make sure to bring a lot of friends with you!
His body clearly shows signs of the torture he endured. The Gibberling's death was neither quick nor pleasant.
Rescue Antoine de Vevre from the rebels.

May the Light shine upon you. My name is Nicholas de Vevre, the Elven representative at the Oreshek Stronghold and a councilor to the commander.
You are going to Oreshek to put an end to the rebellion. I've also got a personal request, a very delicate matter.
I am aware that it was thanks to your efforts that the enemy's plans have been disclosed, and the fate of my relative illuminated. If captured, he could become a terrible weapon in the hands of our enemy. We are here to prevent that and save Antoine de Vevre. Don't let my family member be a reason for war.
Pray the Light bless you and your comrades-in-arms.
Who are you? An angel of death, coming at last to relieve my suffering? Or a sadistic jailer, whose pleasure it is to torment a poor broken Elf?
Rescued? I can't believe it... Could it be that all is not yet lost?
Inform Ton Windblower of the scout's death.
Inform Ton the Windblower of the Gibberling Scout's death. Unfortunately, the results of his expedition will be lost to the Gibberlings forever.
Have you managed to find our scout?
Dead! What a loss... My friend. He was a merry, jesting fellow, able to laugh in the face of death. I'm sure he died with a joke on his lips.
Report to Nicholas de Vevre that Antony is saved.

The hope of being rescued had already died in me. I myself had almost died... Your being here restores me to life.

I can feel power rising in me! Now when our enemies are dismayed, and their commanders are in fear and trembling, I can escape this damned Demons' fortress on my own. Don't worry about me. Tell my friend Nicholas that my life is out of danger. Thank you!
Antoine's fate worries me more than anything.
You saved him! The de Vevre family will always look favorably upon you.

characters: Priest of the Church of Light

t: Take the Rebels' Plans to Aidenus in the Novograd.

Hm, you have found some curious papers. Even at a glimpse, I can see that the flame of rebellion could soon flare up in other places - in fact, the whole League could become enveloped in it!
This information will surely be of interest to the Great Mage Aidenus. Take the papers to him, decisions on matters such as this must be made at the highest level.
Yes? What can I do for you?

It seems like it may be too early to be celebrating just yet. I have further evidence here that some of our citizens may not be ready to let go of the old ways. Once they make room for a new Kania, a great and mighty nation that's able to withstand the challenges of this world will rise up!
Report the scout's death to the Grey Family.

I ask you to go back to the Capital and tell the Gray Family about our bereavement. Apparently we'll have to organize another expedition to plough the Astral in search of our homeland.
You have done much for us and I'm sure Asgerd will have something to reward you with for your help. Perhaps, he'll also have another mission for you. Our life here, among the men and Elves, is not as pleasant as one might conclude from looking at my brethrens' carefree faces.
Have you spoken to the Gray Family about the scout's death?

It's a terrible loss...
He was a brave scout, what a pity.
I hope fortune will smile on the other scouts and they will come back safely, bringing happy news.
Your help in this case deserves a reward. Choose what you think will be most useful.
Meet Pierre de Desirae in the Elven Residence.

I ask you to meet with Pierre de Desirae once more. I'm going to escort the Elven magister to the Enclave and help him regain his powers and confidence.
Tell Pierre de Desirae about our victory and do not be shy in asking for a reward - your deeds merit one.
May the Light be with you!
Pierre de Desirae will be expecting you.

Nicholas de Vevre has requested a reward for you and even if he didn't, we are eager to reward you for all you have done. We also propose that we continue our cooperation - there still are many questions left to answer.
Tell the innkeeper, Maya Korchakova, about the new gentleman caller.

I beg your pardon and all that... and I don't even know how to put it. I guess I'll just say it and hope it comes out sounding alright.
Now then, I've heard that you happen to be helping the innkeeper with a certain... er, delicate matter. The concern she had about her... About her marital status, you know.
I'll soon return to the capital since the war is over. I'm going to visit her, have a couple of drinks and, you know, look at her and let her look at me. Perhaps we could, you know...
If you happen to be going in that direction, tell her to get ready. Say "there's a real man coming to comfort the poor widow." Tell her to not make plans with anyone and wait for the real man instead. I'm not one who permits any lechery in my family, you tell her that.

What did you say? And what does he look like? Stately? Oh, I've got to cancel all the appointments now. That's simply dabbling, while this is serious. Got to prepare for the wedding. Why not? The war is over, life goes on!
And this is a present from me, for bringing the good news.
Raise your reputation to Respected with the League Crafters' Guild or the League Suppliers' Guild and obtain an Artisans' Permit. Then return to Lev Polyakov to become a Master Artisan.

Do you want to learn a second profession?

While most do not have the mental capacity to learn the intricacies of more than one profession, it is possible to do. For this reason, only those who have proven their mastery over their first profession will be allowed to train in a second. When your reputation with the League Crafters' Guild is high enough, then Lela de Ardeur will sell you a permit to learn a second profession.

After you get the document you should come to me and I'll immediately register you as a Master Artisan with permission to learn a second profession. All clear? Good, I'll be waiting for you here if you get approved.
Becoming a Master Artisan brings both honor and great profit.

Few people are capable of so much perseverance and endurance. But these qualities are necessary in a Master Artisan!
Return to me once you have proven yourself worthy.
Participate in killing the Rabid Sabertooth Squirrel and report to Matvey Shramov.

And here I have another request. There are so many of them! Apparently there have been some complaints concerning the terrible disease known as rabies. There has already been a few cases reported among the beasts of Lightwood.
If you're an unlucky hunter, a run-in with one of these creatures could spell your doom. The best thing you can do once you've contracted the disease is off yourself immediately. Sad, but there's no cure for it at the moment.
Since there's no cure, the least we can do is put down the beasts spreading the disease. A large blue sabertooth squirrel with symptoms of rabies has been spotted in the Lake Tract. You are ordered to put down the beast, but make sure you don't go alone. You can ripped apart by her teeth or worse, contract the disease yourself.
A rabid squirrel is one of the most terrible monsters in all of Sarnaut!
That should help curb the rabies epidemic! Good work! Oh and one more thing, you might want to get yourself checked for any infected wounds.
Participate in killing Mizgir and report to Pakhom Rogov.

I recently read a very interesting book called "The Way of the Warrior". It's by the Elven scholar Claude de Vevre. For several years he lived alone on an allod amongst a tribe of wild minotaurs, studying their customs and beliefs. These minotaurs believe that their life is a path that they must travel. One of the first obstacles in their way is overcoming their fears.
Me... well I have a terrible fear I don't think I'll ever be able to overcome. I'm afraid of spiders! I can hardly stand when I see one!
Not too far away on Adder Plateau there are a whole bunch of spiders. Among them is a huge one that the woodsmen have nicknamed Mizgir. I'd like to try and kill some of the smaller spiders myself to overcome my fears, but I can't go near the Plateau with Mizgir there!
Please cleanse the world of that monster for me!
I know my limits. Defeating a simple spider is the way to start overcoming my fears! Mizgir's way beyond me.

I bow before you! To defeat Mizgir... how amazing! Well, now I have no more excuses. I should go there and confront some of the smaller spiders face to face. Alright. Here I go. Right... now! Or maybe later. Are you sure Mizgir's really dead?
Speak with the auctioneer in Novograd's Main Square.

Hear me!
The Novograd auction house is always open and ready to serve the citizens of the League! Say "Yes" to free trade! Share your trophy items or the fruit of your labors with others!
You there! Have you ever used our great Novograd auction house? If you haven't, I'd recommend it! The auction house is located in Novograd's Main Square, on the side of Aidenus' Tower. Go talk to the auctioneer, he'll tell you everything there is to know.
Ah, another potential buyer or seller! Would you like to know more about the auction house? Just ask me!
Speak with the banker in Novograd's Main Square.

Hear me!
The Novograd Bank is open! Now everyone can store valuables with the bank for a pittance! Visit Novograd Bank in the Main Square, to the left of Aidenus' Tower!
The Bank is great! I recently rented a deposit box there and I now keep my valuables in it! I suggest you do the same! It couldn't be easier - just talk to the banker and he'll tell you everything.
How can I help? Would you like to safely store your valuables? Our bank is the best place for this.
Speak with Guild Master Oleg Shpilev by the northern gates of Novograd.

Hear ye! Hear ye!
We all know that there is safety in numbers! In view of this Aidenus, the Great Mage, has issued an order that allows citizens of the League to establish guilds to solve difficult problems together. You can set up your guild right here in Novograd by speaking to the Guild Master Oleg Shpilev! Free citizens of the League, unite!
He's in the first house to the left of the northern gate of Novograd. Talk to him and he'll fill you in on the rest of the details.
A Guild is a wonderful thing! I can't imagine how we ever lived without them.
Meet with Feodor Vetrov at the Cape of Good Hope.

You might have heard of the Twelve Great Martyrs already. They were twelve Great Mages who gave their lives after the Great Cataclysm to protect the allods from the Astral. Their spirits still linger in the Astral, and people have found a way to call upon their powers and make one of them their patrons.
Anyway, I have good news for you. I heard that a druid by the name of Feodor Vetrov is willing to help others make one of the Twelve Great Martyrs their patron. I would advise that you meet him at the Cape of Good Hope in Siveria and do everything he says.

Are you here to undergo the initiation ritual and earn the protection of one of the Twelve Great Martyrs? Hm...
It's not easy to do, you know...
Bring one "For" token and one "Against" token to the Novograd Guide. They are located in the Allods Boutique which can be accessed from the icon in the lower left hand corner of your screen.

Hear ye! Hear ye!
This week the Great Mage Aidenus has decreed that all citizens of the League will be able to vote on the newest laws that govern our great country! Noble or common born, Elf or Gibberling, get yourself to the polls and voice your opinion! Remember that only citizens that are registered will be allowed to cast their votes.
What, you aren't registered? I'm afraid you won't be able to vote then. It takes weeks to process the paperwork you know. Well, since you can't help the League by voicing your opinion, you can do one other thing.
You see, we're almost out of voting tokens! If you could go get me a couple, you'd be doing your part to help this great country by letting someone else use them! Where can you find them? Why, in the Boutique of course! In the "Services" category, you will see "Ballots" shelf. Buying votes won't cost you anything.
Thank you for bringing the tokens to me. The voice of the people is always important!
After you have talked to Divine Prioress Marianne de Ardeur, go to the Wedding Chapel and meet Helena Bugakova, Joiner of Hearts.

Listen, everyone!
If you want to join your soul with your fiance, that is no problem at all!
You just need to talk to the Divine Prioress Darianne de Ardeur and go to the Wedding Chapel. Helena Bugakova, the Joiner of Hearts, is waiting for you. She will tell you everything about the ceremony.
Dear beloved! Be joined in matrimony!

Greetings to you!
If you want to register a legal marriage, the Wedding Chapel is the right place.
Talk to the Mercenary Captain Vlastemir Naimitov in the port of Novograd.
If you have not yet found loyal comrades-in-arms who could help you through group instances, you can use the mercenaries. Vlastemir Naimitov will tell you more about them.
We resolve all problems - all you have to do is pay!

Oh, I've been chattering to you too much, it seems. We mercenaries don't earn money with our tongues, but with our blades. So, if you need help, we are always at your service. Call me when you have need of reliable warriors, and for a reasonable fee my boys will rip whoever you want to shreds! As a demonstration of our capabilities the first contract is free!
Use the Mercenary Contract spell from your spellbook to summon the Mercenary Captain while having a Free Mercenary Contract with you and being in a group adventure.

No, I am not joking! These days nobody takes you at your word. But you know, we value our reputation as the best mercenary squad more than gold. And so, exclusively to show our ability to resolve any problems in return for adequate payment, my mercenaries are prepared to work for you once for free. When you encounter the need to travel to somewhere where you cannot go alone, remember my words. You already know the special spell that will allow you to summon me at any moment. So, don't be shy about using it if you need to! And remember - the first time we will help you completely free of charge. When you see how my boys deal with your enemies, you will be back again to avail of their services, you'll see!
I think that you are faced with a dangerous adventure. And where there's danger, there is gold!

What, is it time for my boys to show what they are capable of? Well, choose who you want, and off you go to crush the enemy! But I will take the free contract from you, and the next time our help will cost you a few gold coins.
Ask Dmitry Grabov at the docks about the Profession Book and bring the book back to Vasily Lykov.

Oh, I'm such an idiot! Such an idiot! I wanted to become a master artisan so I chose a trade, begged a master to teach me, and bought a training manual. And what happened? I lost my book!
I spent every coin I had on that book hoping I could make it all back with my new skills. Without it I'm broke and without a job! Maybe after a few months I could pull together enough money for a new book, but if I found the one I lost, that would be the end of my sorrows!
Look, I saw this suspicious guy take off towards the docks with something under his arm. He must have taken my book when I dropped it! If I can't get my book back, there'll be nothing left for me to do but ask for handouts! Please help!
Oh, where could my book have gone? I'm in so much trouble!

I don't believe my eyes! That's my book! Remember this lesson - if you decide to learn a profession, choose wisely and keep the book safe! You'll have to pay through the nose for a second chance to learn something useful!
Activate your patron's rune and show your results to the Mysterious Family.

It's time to begin your rune training.
The first lesson is learning how to activate a rune. It'll grant you additional powers, because this is a rune of your Patron. It's a simple task, so I'm sure you'll be able to do it.
Have you completed the task yet?
Good work, your first lesson is complete. Here's your reward. You may exchange the coupon for Crystal Chips at the Boutique.
Use the Rune Welder to combine 2 level one runes in your bag, receive level two rune and report to the Mysterious Family.

The second lesson is about combining runes.
For this lesson you will need to purchase the Rune Welder from our shop to combine two runes using gold dust and crystal chips. And as I'm sure you're already aware, I've rewarded you with the crystal chips and gold dust from our second lesson.
Use you Rune Welder to fuse two runes to create a more powerful one. But remember to unpack your crystal chips! Go on, it's simple, really.
Did you somehow manage to lose your crystal chips? Don't worry, you can purchase more from the Boutique.
Now that wasn't so hard was it? Good work, your third lesson is now complete.
Speak with Maurice de Ardeur at the Astral Academy.

Hear ye! Hear ye!
Everyone who has dreamt of Astral voyages and great discoveries can now turn their dreams into reality! The League Astral Academy is willing to help you build your own Astral ship! Maurice de Ardeur, the Ship Master, will answer all of your questions on this subject!
The Astral Academy is located just a short distance away to the north of Novograd. Go there now and take possession of the Astral! Challenge demons, pirates and the Xadaganian fleet!
You're still here? Go on and talk to the Ship Master! Well, I guess it's up to you, but if it weren't for my family and other responsibilities... I'd be off prowling the Astral myself!
So, you also want to build your own Astral Ship? I can help you with that.
Take the ship from the Novograd Port to Asee-Teph and give Yaroslav Glebov the Valuable Package.

Listen, I have a personal favor to ask of you. My old friend Yaroslav Glebov set off for the Holy Land quite a while ago. He's the captain of a Kanian ship, and the Army is always in need of his services. It's understandable I suppose - there is a war going on.
His wife hasn't seen him for quite some time so she asked me to send Laurus this package for her. Because it's so very important, I was hoping I could find someone to personally deliver it.
Do you think you could help me out? I would take it myself, but if I leave there won't be anyone to do my duties in Novograd. So, are you up for it?
This should also be a great chance for you to try out an Astral passenger ship if you haven't had much chance to use one yet. Just go to the Novograd Port and board the ship that's going to the Holy Land. It should be quite a smooth ride, I assure you!

Oh, I hate being stuck in the Holy Land! I miss Novograd, my wife, my friends...
I wish it was time to go home!
What is it? Is that for me? Oh, how nice! My wife went out of her way to send me my favorite tobacco. Thanks for bringing it!
Collect 100 Astral Azurites, 80 Astral Chrysolites and 60 Astral Topazes to get a Ruby. Report to Izbor Yavorsky.

Now when you reach level 40, it's time to get acquainted with the Astral gemstones.

As you already know, everyone is on there own way. You go on the Hero's way. The purpose of your journey - Perfection and for this you need to get Rubies.

Now you have the opportunity to get an additional Ruby.

I am granting you the ability to see Astral gemstones. Search the veins of Astral Azurites, Chrysolites and Topazes. Get the right amount of these stones, come back for your prize.
For successful development you need new Rubies.
Great! Congratulations. You've taken another important step on the path to Perfection.
Collect 100 astral azurites, 80 astral chrysolites and 60 astral topazes to get a Ruby. Report to your trainer in the capital upon completion.
Talk to Lyubava Grosheva at the main square of Novograd.

Hear ye! Hear ye!
Know that henceforth you can officially trade Crystals for gold and gold for Crystals! Currency exchange rate is set by the National Bank and controlled by the Great Aidenus himself!
Lyubava Grosheva has been appointed as the official money changer. Meet her if you want to buy Crystals or sell the excess!
Do you want to trade gold for Crystals, or vice versa? I'll explain you how.

Wow, do you look pale! It's enough with the hard work. You have to have a bit of rest now. If I were you, I would go to the Tropical Atoll. Swim in the sea, sunbathe some, you know. Can't break your back.
Do you know how to get there? Ask, don't be shy. Find Zouzou "Seven Steps" as soon as you arrive, he'll show you around.
Welcome to the best allod of Sarnaut! Let's celebrate your vacation!
Talk to Travel Agent in Novograd.

Hear ye! Hear ye! From now on, any League citizen can fulfill their dream of having a holiday at a sea resort! Everyone is invited to the Tropical Atoll - enjoy swimming and sunbathing on this new Astral isle, the most welcoming of all! Speak to a travel agent in Novograd to learn how to get there.
Hello! Do you want to have a holiday? Ask me if you want to learn more of the Tropical Atoll.
Measure the beauty of each competitor and return to Pierre de Ardeur.

The Great Ball is approaching! Soon the Elves of every house will come together to show off their magic and beauty.

We, the Elves of the House de Ardeur, have decided to organize a beauty contest. We'll scour every town and village on every allod for the League's most stunning ladies. Elven maidens, Kanian girls, and Gibberling... hm... females! I've been charged with organizing the beauty contest in Novograd.

The candidates of all three races are waiting impatiently for a decision. Which one of them will be crowned as the Lady of Novograd? Who will choose for us?

No, we've decided against entrusting this difficult task to the jury. They may be experienced in matters of beauty, but there's always the risk of prejudice. We will not admit any doubts in this regard!

That's why we, the craftsmen of the House de Ardeur, have created a wonderful device. It has been programmed with all existing notions of beauty, from waist size to the ability to hold a conversation. The device is a Magic Mirror and you can use it to identify the winner.

If a lady meets all of the criteria the Magic Mirror will respond by releasing fireworks. Go and find the answer to the eternal question - "Who's the fairest of them all?"
Of course, the Elven beauty will be the winner of our contest. The only thing left to do is to wait for the results...

What?!

The Magic Mirror declared all of the girls to be beauties? It can't be... Or...

Oh, I suspected it long ago!

You know, the more worldly and sophisticated you are, the more beauty you will see in all of the world's phenomena and creatures! That Magic Mirror is truly the most sophisticated out of all of us! That must be why everything is beautiful to it! Everything and everyone!

Oh, this discovery is going to turn everyone's ideas about beauty upside down! Could it be that those clumsy Kanians and that vulgar joke of theirs about how "there are no ugly women" is true?

Honestly, I'm in shock!
Measure the beauty of each competitor and return to Pierre de Ardeur.

The Great Ball is approaching! Soon the Elves of every house will come together to show off their magic and beauty.
We, the Elves of the House de Ardeur, have decided to organize a beauty contest. We'll scour every town and village on every allod for the League's most stunning ladies. Elven maidens, Kanian girls, and Gibberling... hm... females! I've been charged with organizing the beauty contest in Novograd.
And you, a paladin, a paragon of virtue, are as good a helper as any in this pageant! The candidates of all three races are waiting impatiently for a decision. Which one of them will be crowned as the Lady of Novograd? Who will choose for us?
No, we've decided against entrusting this difficult task to judges. They may be experienced in matters of beauty, but there's always the danger of them not being impartial. We can't afford doubt concerning such situations!
That's why we, the craftsmen of the House de Ardeur, have created a wonderful device. It has been programmed with all existing notions of beauty, from waist size to the ability to hold a conversation. The device is a magic mirror and you can use it to identify the winner. If a lady meets all of the criteria the magic mirror will respond by releasing fireworks.
Go and find the answer to the eternal question -"Who's the fairest of them all?"
Of course, the Elven beauty will be the winner of our contest. The only thing left to do is to wait for the results...

What?! The magic mirror declared all of the girls to be beauties? It can't be... Or... Oh, I suspected it long ago!
You know, the more worldly and sophisticated you are, the more beauty you will see in all of the world's phenomena and creatures! That magic mirror is truly the most sophisticated out of all of us! That must be why everything is beautiful to it! Everything and everyone!
Oh, this discovery is going to turn everyone's ideas about beauty upside down! Could it be that those clumsy Kanians and that vulgar joke of theirs about how "there are no ugly women" is true? Honestly, I'm in shock!
Give 5 flowers to the gibberling families in the neighborhood and report back to the Gray Family.

And now on to a more important task!

What do you see when you look around? A city, right? It's not just a city, it's a capital! But you can't see the sky for all our stone walls! Novograd is a beautiful city, we won't argue that. But endless plains and fields are much more dear to us Gibberlings.

We're always eager to support each other and raise our spirits - especially here in this city. Those flowers that you brought us will help to bring joy to the Gibberlings.

As we said earlier, it's a real pleasure to receive flowers. But it's more pleasant to give them! Do you understand what we're talking about? Oh, of course you do!

Take these flowers and give them to a few nearby Gibberlings.

Give them a gift of joy! It won't be forgotten!

What could be better than getting a present?

That's right - giving a present!

Wonderful! I hear it! I hear the happy cries of Gibberlings who received an unexpected gift!

Ah, if only all of the problems in the world could be solved so simply...
Give flowers to the Bouncer Family, the Buggy Family, the Dainty Family, the Gravel Family, and the Stormy Family and report back to the Gray Family.

And now on to a more important task!
What do you see when you look around? A city, right? It's not just a city, it's a capital! But you can't see the sky for all our stone walls! Novograd is a beautiful city, we won't argue that. But endless plains and fields are much more dear to us Gibberlings.
We're always eager to support each other and raise our spirits - especially here in this city. Those flowers that you brought us will help to bring joy to the Gibberlings.
As we said earlier, it's a real pleasure to receive flowers. But it's more pleasant to give them! Do you understand what we're talking about? Oh, of course you do!
Take these flowers and give them to a few nearby Gibberlings. Give them a gift of joy! It won't be forgotten!
What could be better than getting a present? That's right - giving a present!
Wonderful! I hear it! I hear the happy cries of Gibberlings who received an unexpected gift! Ah, if only all of the problems in the world could be solved so simply...
Oh, there's no place to play hide-and-seek in this city...
Did you know our birthday is coming up soon?
Oh... an early birthday gift! How touching! Hurray! Hurray! Time for a celebration!
Ah, are those for us? They're so nice! Thank you! We're so happy!
We want to make a scene... we know, we need some Orcs! They're pretty violent!
Flowers? For us? We asked for an Orc! Well, we guess flowers are nice too... thanks!
No one loves us... Nobody pays us any attention...
Flowers! They've noticed us! Someone is interested in us! Hurray, what a happy day!
Life is a wonderful thing! There's always something interesting going on.
See, our words are true! We've been given some flowers! We were right - life is good!
Giving presents is a way more pleasant than receiving them!

Visit the Church of Light in the Main Square of Novograd and complete the initiation ceremony by following the instructions you received and report the ritual's completion to Izbor Yavorsky, the head of the League Defenders.

Wait a moment! Hmm, you haven't passed a Consecration Ritual. This is unacceptable!

Every Kanian man or woman, regardless of their beliefs, must pass the Consecration Ritual and accept Light into their hearts. It is an edict of Voisvet himself!

The Church of Light awaits you! Go there immediately and do everything prescribed to you by the church's canons. Believe me, this will be better for everyone, especially for you.

The ritual is quite simple. First of all, you must talk to the first priest of the Church of Light and confess your sins.

Secondly, you must take communion by touching the pedestal with the Holy Testaments of Tensess.

Thirdly, a second priest must anoint you with holy oil.

After that, you must be baptized in holy water.

And lastly, you must accept the oath of the Church of Light. This will be done by a third priest of the Church of Light.

All clear? Go and don't come back until you pass the ritual. Understand that in the future you will have to fight the cunning Imperials and many merciless demons.

How will you fare in these battles without accepting the Light into your heart?

Belief in the sacrifice of Tensess and the Church of Light unite us Kanians!

Everyone must pass the Initiation. Strength through unity!

Now you're one of us, and the Light will eternally shine on your path.

I reward you with the opportunity to improve your knowledge. Use it wisely!

The Church of Light awaits you! Go there immediately and do everything prescribed to you by the church's canons. Believe me, this will be better for everyone, especially for you.

Secondly, you must take communion by touching the pedestal with the Holy Testaments of Tensess.
Thirdly, a second priest must anoint you with holy oil. After that, you must be baptized in holy water.
And lastly, you must accept the oath of the Church of Light. This will be done by a third priest of the Church of Light.
All clear? Go and don't come back until you pass the ritual. Understand that in the future you will have to fight the cunning Imperials and many merciless demons.
How will you fare in these battles without accepting the Light into your heart?

Belief in the sacrifice of Tensess and the Church of Light unite us Kanians!
Everyone must pass the Initiation. Strength in unity!

Now you are with us. And the Light from now on will enlighten your path!
As a reward, I give you the possibility of becoming more proficient in your discipline. Use your knowledge for the good of Kania and the League!
May the great Tensess be with you!

Everybody has sinned. Even Tensess says in his Testament, that "there is no single creature in the world who never violated any virtues. May this not become an obstacle on the way to the enlightenment! Everyone can abandon the old sins and let the Light into their souls by saying: Nay to Evil, I Praise the Light!"
Here you are, you have come and said the words to receive the blessing of the Light. May those who was harmed by you, forgive you, as the Light has long done!
Go in peace now.

Now you're one of us, and the Light will eternally shine on your path.
I reward you with the opportunity to improve your knowledge. Use it wisely!
Gather a Sack of Flour and deliver it to Vlad Mikhailov.

Hey, you there! C'mere. Look, my back is killing me but someone has to take this flour back to the mill for storage.
I bet you could knock out a bear with one punch! You can carry one measly bag of flour to the mill, can't ya? What am I saying? Of course you can!
The bags are on the ground right behind me. Just pick one up and deliver it to Vlad Mikhailov, the miller. He'll be sure to reward you.
Hey! What are you doing with my flour?!

Konstantin Mukhov sent you? That lazy ass! He should be bringing these sacks over here himself. What am I paying him for? Here, take this - they're his wages for today. You should be the one to get them.

It looks like someone tried to hide something here! Or maybe someone found it and was ambushed! It looks like both parties were killed in the battle for the chest. It seems pretty shady...
But either way, this chest has no owner and no one is around to stop you from claiming this for yourself.
Thank the skeletons for the chest and be on your way. Hopefully there's something of value still left in the old thing!

It looks like someone tried to hide something here! Or maybe someone found it and was ambushed! It looks like both parties were killed in the battle for the chest. It seems pretty shady...
But either way, this chest has no owner and no one is around to stop you from claiming this for yourself.
Thank the skeletons for the chest and be on your way. Hopefully there's something of value still left in the old thing!
Find the hidden treasure to the east and report your success to the Acrobatic Family.

Do you know what us Gibberlings are famous for? Our kindness and selflessness!
What? You don't believe us? Well, here's your proof! Trusted Gibberling sources tell us that a treasure is hidden somewhere in the eastern mountains, the natural border of Lightwood.
If you find it, you can keep it for yourself! That's how kind and selfless we are! But you should hurry. Our kindness and selflessness are so great that everyone else already knows about the treasure. They're all looking for it too. What fun, a race!
We wonder who'll find the treasure first.
So, you found the treasure! Good job! Oh, but the others didn't get anything. What a shame. Oh well, we Gibberlings are kind and selfless, whatever they may say!
Disperse 20 lost souls in Lightwood and report to Anna Kavelina in Novograd.

Light bless you, my child. I would like to entrust you with a very important job. Perhaps it's not as dangerous or glorious as your usual heroic deeds, but I don't have anyone else I can turn to. Have you already met any lost souls? Poor creatures, doomed to forever walk in the world which doesn't welcome them any more... They would like to die, but they can't. Our sacred duty, the duty of anyone who believes in the Light is to give them peace. There are many lost souls in Lightwood, left behind after the recent battles. I beg you, please disperse them, lay them to rest and put and end to their torture. You will be handsomely rewarded! You will receive Tears of the Dragon and a Shard of a Frozen Tear of the Dragon as a reward!
Go with the Light, my child!
It's our sacred duty to bring peace to restless souls!

May your path be blessed by the Light, my child

A righteous deed never goes unnoticed. Take these Tears of the Dragon. You will find them useful in your adventures. This is a shard of a Frozen Tear of the Dragon. If you manage to collect enough shards to get a Frozen Tear, you will never have to worry about replenishing your Tears supply again.
Go to the Purgatory by drinking instant poison, dispense mirra to the dead you find there, and report to Anna Kavelina in Novograd.

Mercy towards the fallen is the best virtue!
When the Light came into this world, death stopped being the end of life but merely a quick breather. Purgatory is not exactly a place where I'd want to spend my free time. But you already knew that, right? Everyone knows that heroes are frequent visitors to Purgatory! Which isn't exactly the case for the rest of us. For the little people, every minute in Purgatory is a terrible torture! However, we can ease their pain by showing mercy. I hope that you will be able to help me with this hard task.
I will give you poison. If you drink it, you will go directly to the world beyond. I will also give you mirra - it will help you to come back here. And not just you! Share your mirra with anyone who has been stuck in Purgatory for a long time, regardless of whether they serve the Empire or the League. Help the sufferers to come back to life and your mercy will return to you a hundredfold! You will receive Tears of the Dragon and a Shard of a Frozen Tear of the Dragon as a reward!
Our faith is built on mercy!

May your path be blessed by the Light, my child! A righteous deed never goes unnoticed. Take these Tears of the Dragon. You will find them useful in your adventures. This is a Shard of a Frozen Tear of the Dragon. If you manage to collect enough shards to get a Frozen Tear, you will never have to worry about replenishing your Tears supply again.
This place does have a certain deathly charm about it. However, after spending some time here, I am beginning to understand that I prefer serving the Empire to staying in otherworldly peace.
Thank you! I will return to work as soon as I can. As the Imperial motto goes: "Do or die!"
Repel the invasion of demons to the Cradle and report to Anna Kavelina in Novograd.

I have a task for you. You're the one to deal with the invasion of demonic creatures... What creatures? The ones attacking the Cradle. It seems that the demons are trying to destroy the portal that leads to the Dead City! I don't know what they are after, but I am sure that it heralds trouble for us. So, if you hate demons as much as I do, then please call up for your friends, go to the Cradle, lure out the demons that are circling around it and destroy as many of these astral fiends as you can! You will receive Tears of the Dragon and a Shard of a Frozen Tear of the Dragon as a reward!
Demons are the scourge of our world. We fight them everywhere, but it doesn't seem to make even a dent in their numbers...

May your path be blessed by the Light, my child! A righteous deed never goes unnoticed. Take these Tears of the Dragon. You will find them useful in your adventures. This is a Shard of a Frozen Tear of the Dragon. If you manage to collect enough shards to get a Frozen Tear, you will never have to worry about replenishing your Tears supply again.
Complete seven Anna Kavelina's quests to receive your reward.

Greetings, child. I have heard a lot about your good deeds, and I can see you are always willing to help the Church of Light. This is good.

We are living in the hard days. Demons are attacking different allods all over the world. We suffer great losses, not to mention the consequences of the stupid riot. What's the result of it? Wandering souls appear here and there in the Lightwood, and our best soldiers and innocent citizens are stuck in the Purgatory in great numbers.

I will give you one quest a day. Complete seven quests, and I will give you a good rewards - shards of a Frozen Tear of the Dragon. If you combine them, you will obtain a most powerful weapon, worthy of a hero like you.

May the Light bless you!
Light will never leave its child unattended. Always remember about it.

I knew I could rely on you, child. Thanks to your bravery the world has become a little better. Alas, the war is not over, not even if you want it. Come back to me every week. I always have enough tasks to keep a hero like you busy.

Here's your rewards - shards of a Frozen Tear of the Dragon. You may combine them and receive a great tool for fighting the enemies of Sarnaut.
Confirm that you've understood everything about the Recruit's Chest.

Recruit's Chest is a special item used for improving your gear. Open it to receive a new piece of equipment useful for your class and level that can replace the most outdated of your items.
If your equipment is good enough for your level, you will receive gold instead of item, the amount depends on your level.
Recruit's Chests are given away automatically as you complete quests

If you already have a Recruit's Chest, open it to receive your reward. If you don't, complete more quests.
And remember - sharing and completing quests together is fun and profitable!
Complete three quests from Lily de Desirae and Vsemil Snowdrop.
You! Hey, you! Come up. See, how much job I've got to do? Help me a bit, will you? Just three simple requests for me and Vsemil, and I'll give you a nice gift of spring! Will you? Please?
Who dragged the damn fir tree saplings? I don't need those! What are you doing here? Out of tasks? Well, I do have some!
Phew, thank you so much! I'm so much relieved now. Here, this is for you.
Collect a bouquet of 5 flowers and give it to another player character.
Why would you throw flowers? It's so childish!
Ah, see, you are in a festive mood, everyone around is in a festive mood, I'm the only one who stresses out. Somebody printed a whole box of cards upside down!

Isn't it wonderful to see smiles and flowers all around? You're going to help me with both! Here are enchanted flower seeds that will grow and bloom within seconds! I wish they would grow outside harbor... But at least we can decorate it here. Plant all five in different spots, let the flowers bloom!

Wait a minute, show me the packet of your seeds! …Phew, they're fine. A druid mixed up the Spring seeds with the Day of Fun seeds the other day, and believe me, you don't want to know what has grown...
They look and smell so nice!
Teleport to the harbor and speak to Lily de Desirae and Vsemil Snowdrop.

So many things to do about the celebrations! There are three of us, that makes it all a lot easier. But not too easy, after all. We still need helpers. Want to earn a couple of gifts? Good. We decided to organize celebrations in the harbor this year. Go there and talk to Lily de Desirae and Vsemil Snowdrop, they've got plenty to do too.
Flowerbeds, check. Cards, check. Wings... Has anyone seen the wings? Oh, here they are. Whew.
Where are the seeds? Didn't I ask you to have them ready? How can... oh sorry, it's you. Want to help? Right on time, I should say.

Military service is voluntary, of course, but not after you've sworn to serve and protect. An oath you give is your pledge to join the ranks. I wish some people could really understand this. But no, first they sign up to serve, and then they listen to the rumors about the Holy Land and flee, chase the wind! Then they have to go into hiding, mix up with the criminals, that's how it all goes downhill. Today, to celebrate the spring, Aidenus decided to give deserters a second chance. Here's the pardon decree. It says, if a deserter returns to his regiment, he's granted the amnesty. Find five deserters and read the decree to them. Perhaps it will make them come back.
What kind of a celebration it is, when there are people ruining their own lives?
Five deserters listened to the decree. That's good. There's hope they will return to the army to defend their motherland, like their grandfathers did!
Talk to Vera Shilova, Maya Korchakova and Vasily Lykov. Report to Vsemil Snowdrop.

Poor Lily, her work always falls apart. Misdirections, misdeliveries, failures... Why is that, you ask? That's because communication net is poorly organized. And then, look at me. I've got couriers at hand all the time! By the way, will you do me a favor? I need one right now to deliver messages to Vera Shilova, Maya Korchakova and Vasily Lykov. Be back in a flash then!
Fast work makes a good courier. Got my point?
Nice. Now go to Lily de Desirae. She's bound to face problems.
Approve Iberian Izbor to help Women's celebration.

Now, listen. Do you know what happened this day 100 years ago? Night of Astral portals. First invasion of the demons. This day died a lot of Kanians, Elves, Gibberlings. Tensess died. But we stand out!
That day when the first units of League Seekers were formed. They took the blow and saved allods.
Now when the demonic threat is eliminated, this day becomes one more holiday in our calendar. We pay homage to the fallen and honor those who came to replace them. New League Seekers!
However, in planning of the celebration was a mistake! Somehow we decided that we need to congratulate only men... Thankfully we thought better of it in time and remember that the victory was produced not only by men. Without women, nothing would have happened.
Situation must be corrected. Are you ready to help me congratulate all of our beautiful and charming women?
Perfect! I knew I could trust you.
Defeat a Xadaganian, an Arisen and an Orc, then talk to Iberian Izbor.

Ah, Defender of the Fatherland! Glad to see you.
But don't forget that real men find their fun in battles. Time to kick Imperial ass! Defeat a Xadaganian, an Arisen and an Orc to celebrate the holiday!
Having the confidence of the Spring Council, you can buy very useful things.

Well done!
You are in a good shape, no wonder that you are Defender of the Fatherland.
Give a greeting cards to the three women of the League.

That's one of my tasks.
I'll give you three cards, you need to distribute to women. In each of them - beautiful pictures, lovely poems... Everything that women love so much! And if the woman realizes that she is loved... hmm, believe me, for us men to live in this world is much easier! She feels Chosen! She... becomes more beautiful, if it's possible. And the other important thing - the owner of such a title has great confidence and it is easier for her to earn a reputation.
Come back when you have completed this task, and I'll give you another one.
Completing these tasks, you can improve your reputation with the "Spring Council." It was set up recently, specifically for these holidays.
Believe me, sometimes to make a woman happy, you need just a nice piece of paper with heartfelt words on it.

Great.
Now I can give you new task.
Recommend you to go to the Maya Korchakova's Inn. She could have some task for you as well.
Present a red roses to the three women of the League.

Here is one of my tasks.
I'll give you three red roses, which you should present to women. Only flowers were always a most welcome gift for the beautiful ladies. Why? I'll tell you honestly - I don't understand. I think the point is that the flowers are beautiful and giving them to a woman we are telling her that she is the same wonderful and delicate creation, like this flower.
Come back when you complete this task and I can give you another one.
Completing these tasks, you can improve your reputation with the "Spring Council." It was established recently, specifically for these holidays.
These roses are beautiful...But I think that women are 100 times more beautiful!

Perfect.
I'm ready to give you a new task
I recommend you to go to the Maya Korchakova's Inn. She could have some task for you as well.
Distribute invitations to the three women of the League.

That's one of my tasks.
I'll give you three invitations to give them to women. That one, whom you invite will be able to come to the Spring Council Quartermaster and receive a valuable gift. From the huge trunk. I believe, the real gift is as important to women, as a flower or a kind word.
Come back when you complete this task, and I'll give you another one.
Completing these tasks, you can improve your reputation with the "Spring Council." It was established recently, specifically for these holidays.

Women are also very practical.
And they will be happy about gifts no less than we are with you.

Perfect.
If you are ready I can give you a new task
I recommend you to go to the Maya Korchakova's Inn. She could have some task for you as well.
Drink 10 cups of a light Ginger beer and stay sober, report to Maya Korchakova about your win.

Here he is! Real man! Welcome to my inn!
Only in these spring holidays we have here special people's fun for real men. It is necessary to drink 10 cups in a row of light ginger beer and stay sober. Just do it, yes...
But the winner will be able to increase the level of his reputation with the Spring Council. Izbor gave me such permission.
You can only take part in the competition once a day.
Participation rules are simple. I give you 10 cups of light ginger beer, you drink them, and if after the last cup your condition doesn't change - you're a winner!

This competition is for real men! My husband, God rest his soul, could drink a dozen in a row.
He was capable of more...

You're a giant!
When all this spring confusion will be finished - come to my house this evening. Let's sit and chat. Like friends!
Approve Iberian Izbor to help Men celebration.

4th of March is not far away.
Do you know what happened this day 100 years ago?
Night of Astral portals. First invasion of demons. This day died a lot of Kanians, Elves, Gibberlings. Tensess died. But we stand out!
That was the day when the first units of League Seekers were formed. They took the blow and saved allods.
Now when the demonic threat eliminated, this day becomes one more holiday in our calendar. We pay homage to the fallen and honor those who came to replace them. New League Seekers!
I ask you to help me. Thousands of men, who can fight will be happy to get presents. I need you to help me with this.
Agree?
If yes, so I give you immediately one of my tasks, to men celebration .
Perfect! I knew I could trust you.
Distribute greeting cards for the three men of the League.

That's one of my tasks.
I'll give you three cards, you need to give to men. In each of them three are beautiful and meaningful words that will help a man to understand that he is needed in this world, that he can be world's hope. He is support and protection! Believe me, it's very important for a men to know it! On receiving this, he can feel like a real Defender of the Fatherland! A holder of such a title has great confidence and it is easier to earn a reputation.
Come back when you complete this task, and I'll give you another one.
Completing these tasks, you will be able to improve your reputation with the "Spring Council." It was established recently, specifically for these holidays.
Attention and recognition of his contribution is as important for men as a compliment for a woman!

Great.
Now I can give you new task.
Recommend you to go to the Maya Korchakova's Inn. She could have some task for you as well.
Give a red carnations to the tree men of the League.

That's one of my tasks.
I'll give you three red carnations, which you should give to men. Yes! Not only women love getting flowers. Men, too. Here is important not so much a gift, but attention! Especially from a women.
Come back when you complete this task, and I'll give you another one.
Completing these tasks, you can enhance your reputation with the "Spring Council." It was established recently, specifically for these holidays.
Believe me, for the sake of female attention a man is ready to do a lot. Maybe even everything!

Perfect.
I'm ready to give you a new task
I recommend you to go to the Maya Korchakova's Inn. She could have some task for you as well.
Give the invitations to the three men of the League.

That's one of my tasks.
I'll give you three invitations to give them to the men. That one, whom you invite will be able to come to the Spring Council Quartermaster and receive a valuable gift. From the huge trunk. I believe, each of the men can find something valuable for himself.
Come back when you complete this task, and I'll give you another one.
Completing these tasks, you can improve your reputation with the "Spring Council." It was established recently, right for these holidays.

Gifts, especially valuable... Everyone loves it!
Especially men. They're just really big kids...

Perfect.
If you are ready I can give you a new task
I recommend you to go to the Maya Korchakova's Inn. She could have some task for you as well.
Using a cosmetics set you should apply 10 times without damaging your makeup. When the task is successfully complete inform Martha Convolutina.

Hello, beautiful!
Is it ok for you that I call you so? We women must stick together! If we are certainly not talking about personal life... Well, you understand me, right?
Actually, about personal life. Izbor instructed me to do some spring festival. And provided me with all necessary requirements. I'm talking about cosmetics! Elven. Very expensive, created using only natural ingredients.
I can give you 10 boxes. Just be careful! If you do something wrong, everything will be failed. Failure makeup - this is how it will be called!
Well? Do you want to make your self beautiful? If everything goes good - prize to you. A kind word will tell to a Spring Council.
Makeup art - is a great thing. As a widow with experience, I 'm telling you!

Perfect. Even a bit envious!
You can use makeup, even I can learn from you.
Shoot the Arrows of Passion at five Kanians, Elves, Gibberlings, Aoidos, and League Pridens and return to Lubava Charova.

Nobody should stay aside during Love Festival! I'm asking you to take care of your beloved ones and show them your feelings. Find Arrows of Passion among the trophies you loot from fallen enemies and hit five Kanians, Elves, Gibberlings, and League Pridens with them. Be sure I will reward you.
Have you managed to win someone's affection?
Great! Remember that your love will return to you hundredfold!
Find another player blinded by love and give them a Gift of Pure Love, or give a Gift of True Love to Lubava Charova to get rid of the love blindness.

Oh, what a bad luck! You are captured by a fatal passion. It happens when an arrow of passion strikes deep into your heart, causing strong emotions that paralyze your ability to see, hear or even think... You are blinded by love.Here, take this Gift of Pure Love and present it to one who was blinded by love too, just like you. It will help you to understand that careless love is blind and dangerous.
I wish someone gave me a Gift of True Love! Sometimes I regret that I'm not loveblinded.
Blind love is foolish... but still attractive!
Now you should see the difference between true love and fatal passion, which ruined life of many beautiful girls and boys...
Shoot the Arrows of Passion at five Orcs, Xadaganians, Zems, Aoidos and Imperial Pridens then return to Lyubov Serdechkina in Nezebgrad.

The worst enemies may become best friends during the Love Festival, because true love knows no barriers. You can see it yourself!
Obtain Arrows of Passion and strike Empire citizens with them. May your arrows strike love right in their hearts!
Great! Remember that your love will return to you hundredfold!
Shoot the Arrows of Passion at five Kanians, Elves, Gibberlings, Aoidos, and League Pridens.

Arrows of Passion will help you share your feelings with others.
Find five Arrows of Passion and hit those of Elves, League Pridens, Kanians, Aoidos, and Gibberlings who is worth your care and attention. Both you and your target will receive a Gift of Admiration for each arrow, and it will be the first step to great and pure love!
Great! Remember that your love will return to you hundredfold!

Gather 3 Gifts of Admiration by shooting Arrows of Passion at monsters and other characters and return to Lubava Charova in Novograd.

Characters of the opposite faction do not count.

Can you feel the flame of love smoldering in your heart? It depends on you if it is going to grow into a fire of passion, turn into a cozy family hearth or die out, leaving only bitter ashes of disappointment!
Today is Love Festival day and you have a great opportunity to understand your feelings, feel the love and share it. Arrows of Passion will help you with that. You can gather these arrows from the fallen enemies. Their magical power will melt even the most hardened hearts of either warriors, adventurers or monsters!
Now go and shoot three arrows at your enemies, defeat them, and receive Gifts of Admiration. They will appear among your Valuables right away. You will also get them if you just shoot other citizens of the League!
Love thy enemy! After all, your enemies are just reflection of what you cannot admit in yourself. Accept what you are, and love will replace all your feuds!
Read the card to your spouse.

Have you found your couple yet? Today is the best day of the year to find one, and if you already did, use this day to show your other half how much you love them.

This card has a love poem printed on it. Fight enemies, shot with Arrows of Passion, to obtain more cards. During this event, love poetry carry a secret power: reading a poem to the one you are in love with will grant you gifts of Love. The more cards you read, the more generous gifts Love will give you!
See, how wonderful love is! May your love last forever and never die!
Win in any of the specified Skirmishes and receive a reward from Colette de Blizare.

The Treasure Hunt has begun! Don't miss a chance to try your luck! With the help of Prophetic Cards and Ancient Compasses, you can win rare mounts and gorgeous costumes!

Holiday Committee Officials will reward heroes with Ancient Compasses for their feats!

Join the Skirmishes! Witch's Hollow, Deserted Farm, Training Camp, Tower of Order, Battle for Cargallas, and Old Fortress await you. Then come back for your reward!
Who knows what kind of treasures are still waiting to be discovered?
Great! Here is your reward. Good luck in your treasure hunting!
Defeat the toughest opponent on an Astral allod of the current stage and receive the reward form Colette de Blizare.

Treasure hunting has begun! Don't miss the chance to test your luck! With Prophetic Cards and Ancient Compasses you can win rare mounts and gorgeous costumes!

Holiday Committee Officials will reward heroes with Ancient Compasses for their feats!

Defeat the toughest opponent on an Astral allod and return for your reward!
Bring 10 Potent Aloe flowers to official Stepan Ukhanov to improve your reputation with the Novograd Construction Council.

Here's another order. They need some exquisite aloe. Here's one more... And another one! My goodness! I got a drawer full of these orders!
But how am I supposed to process all these orders? I can't figure it out... Perhaps you could help me. Please bring me some aloe. And keep in mind that I can give you this quest again and again! For completing it I'll reward you by improving your reputation with our dear Novograd Construction Council.
I wonder why the residents of Novograd need that much aloe? Have they all caught a cold? Or maybe I don't know something...

Wow, thanks!
If you ever want to help out, we'll be glad to see you!
Ask the Peas Family about Best Friends
Do you have a real friend? Not just a friend, but someone who you can trust your life with? Listen, I will tell you about a rite that will bind you.
Being best friends is a big deal. What to start with?.. Oh, I know - you ask your questions!
This is all about Friendship Rite. I hope you can make good use of it.
Bring Helena Bugakova a Bottle of Champagne in order to get a divorce.

What's wrong? What happened? Why are you so sad?
Ah, I understand you. I understand you well. Your love is gone and your spouse whom you don't want to see anymore won't give consent to divorce, right?
It happens... Everyone can make a mistake and experience such difficulties. Even me when I was young... Ah! Why do my memories of that keep coming back?
To prove to me that you are sure, bring me a Bottle Of Champagne. I will present it to another pair of newlyweds as a souvenir. Let all the bitterness of their marriage be washed away with sparkling wine!
Where is champagne sold? In the Boutique, of course.

So, let's see!
Champagne is just a symbol. It is a symbol of your intention to divorce. Where is the symbol?

Hmph...
You must be really sick of it...
In the name of the League and with the permission of the Light, I pronounce you free from matrimonial ties.
Make an embroidered wallet, a tin glass-holder, a decorated cane or an embroidered shawl and bring them to Lela de Ardeur.

Our workshop is open for everyone with talent and diligence. There's enough work both for experts and newbies. But you don't think that reading a manual is enough to become equal to renowned masters, do you? Do you seek respect and special privileges of the masters' guild? Then earn them!
There are useful items: impenetrable armor, comfortable boots, sharp blades. And then there are useless things that require enormous craftsmanship. It's a custom here that craftsmen make them when they wish to show off before their peers. Blacksmiths boast of their glass holders, leatherworkers brag about their wallets, tailors exhibit their shawls and weaponsmiths show off their canes. If you can make such an item, bring it to me. That will be your first step to recognition.
Not all hard-to-make things are of any use. However, giving a master a chance to display his art is beneficial in and of itself, right?

Oh yes, I see a true master's work here. And now, look what I'll do to it!
Relax... This is tradition: Create a masterpiece at the top of your skill and then destroy it in public as if it were an apprentice's job - that's how you demonstrate your readiness to surpass yourself to your colleagues. You can do it without my help. Create and destroy your creation to remind yourself and others: you are never good enough to stop learning. Craft ever more sophisticated and beautiful things: from an embroidered wallet to an exquisite one, from a tin glass-holder to a gilded one. That's the only way to earn respect of the masters!
Synthesize 20 vials of volatile phlogiston and bring them to Lela de Ardeur.

Our workshop is open for everyone with talent and diligence. There's enough work both for experts and newbies. But you don't think that reading a manual is enough to become equal to renowned masters, do you? Do you seek respect and special privileges of the masters' guild? Then earn them!
Alchemists can brew lots of potions, both medicinal and deadly. Yet to gain true respect of your peers, you'll have to learn to isolate one of the strangest and most elusive substances in Sarnaut: phlogiston, aka thermogen. Make your first step to recognition: bring me 20 vials of this mysterious fluid.
Funny, isn't it: to display their skill, alchemists use a substance they are thus far unable to put to good use!

I can see now - you call yourself an alchemist for a reason. If you have enough skill and patience to obtain phlogiston as well, you can earn the respect of your colleagues without my help: simply release it in front of everyone. Of course, no one will notice a single vial: you'll need a score of them at least. And the further you progress, the higher quality of the substance you'll need: only a novice would boast of volatile phlogiston. To show your skill to the masters, you'll need to brew a strong or even concentrated substance!
Talk to Divine Prioress Marianne de Ardeur to get your Patron.

As I can see you have not managed yet to gain your Patronage?
Sad to hear. I don't know any hero of the League, who could achieve something significant without Patronage.
Listen!
When the wave of the Astral came to Sarnaut and began to devour the world, the Great Magicians were the only ones who could resist the cataclysm. But for power and knowledge are things you always have to pay for! Twelve brave men gave their lives to save the world. They are still with us, they provide us with their protection, they give part of their strength to those who are ready to accept their help.
Now I'll give you the opportunity to get your patron. But you'll have to gain the new levels of Patronage on your own.
Shall we begin?
I don't know who your Patron is, but I'm sure Great Martyrs are never mistaken.

From now on the power of your Martyr will be with you. You can use Martyr's Salvation ability to restore your strength after combat using drops of mirra that I give you. When you spend all of them, you will be able to buy more from Servants of Light.
Who knows, maybe you will have the honor to get the higher ranks of Patronage and your power will increase.
